name: Pharaoh's Baker
title: The Condemned Servant
summary: Pharaoh's baker was a high-ranking court official in Egypt who was imprisoned together with Pharaoh's cupbearer. In prison, he had a dream that Joseph interpreted, which predicted his execution three days later.

keyEvents.title: Imprisoned by Pharaoh
keyEvents.description: The baker was imprisoned together with the cupbearer because they had offended against Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Dream of the Three Baskets
keyEvents.description: The baker dreamed of three baskets of baked goods on his head, from which birds were eating, intended for Pharaoh.

keyEvents.title: Joseph Interprets the Dream
keyEvents.description: Joseph explained that the three baskets meant three days, and that Pharaoh would hang the baker and the birds would eat his flesh.

keyEvents.title: The Execution
keyEvents.description: On the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, the baker was hanged, just as Joseph had predicted.
